subject.title: Telegram: collapse mid-paragraph newlines before sending

question: Should Telegram collapse model-emitted single newlines inside prose/list items by default, expose an opt-in setting, or keep line preservation as the supported behavior?
rationale: Current code and adjacent fixes intentionally preserve single newlines, while the requested behavior changes user-visible formatting and likely requires a compatibility-sensitive Telegram config/default decision.

options.title: Add opt-in collapse policy
options.body: Add a Telegram config option for Markdown-aware soft-wrap collapse, default it off, and document/test preserved blocks plus rich/plain behavior.

options.title: Make collapse the default
options.body: Change Telegram output globally to collapse detected soft-wraps, accepting compatibility risk for users who rely on single-newline preservation.

options.title: Keep preservation behavior
options.body: Close this direction after maintainer confirmation that preserving model newlines is the intended Telegram behavior and point users to prompt or formatting guidance.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in collapse policy
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram config option for Markdown-aware soft-wrap collapse, default it off, and document/test preserved blocks plus rich/plain behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing candidate from blame on the active Telegram formatter/send/config paths and prior maintainer-review context for this product/default decision.
